notes:
User is optimizing their Instagram content strategy to increase engagement and grow their audience.

Current Instagram context:
- Has approximately 1,250 followers and thinks they may now be close to 1,300.
- Already posts regularly and maintains a consistent visual aesthetic.
- Uses or is interested in Instagram Insights to evaluate content performance and audience behavior.
- Audience is mostly located in the US, UK, and Australia.
- Content niche appears to center on content creation, digital marketing, social media strategy, helping entrepreneurs and/or small businesses build an online presence, and creating engaging Instagram content.
- Wants recommendations tailored to their existing audience.
- Is considering using Instagram Live more often.
- Plans to host an Instagram Live Q&A session next and wants advice on making it engaging, interactive, and encouraging viewers to submit questions.
- Is open to collaborations with relevant influencers and content creators.
- Plans to start with micro-influencers, selected Ashley Gaida (@ashleygaida) as a potential collaborator.
- Drafted an Instagram post about a recent industry event and liked Option 1:
  “Just back from [Event Name] and still buzzing from the insights! What was your favorite takeaway from the conference? Share with me in the comments!”
- For that caption, user requested and received niche-specific hashtags: #contentcreation #digitalmarketing #socialmediastrategy.

Topics and recommendations previously provided:
- Analyze account and individual-post performance through Instagram Insights, including reach, impressions, engagement, saves, comments, follower growth, and content performance.
- Review audience demographics, locations, interests, active times, and content themes.
- Identify high-performing formats, topics, captions, hashtags, and posting times, then create more similar content.
- For captions: use a strong opening hook, authenticity, concise and scannable wording, questions, tasteful humor/emojis, relevant hashtags, and a clear but non-forced call to action.
- Suggested caption styles: storyteller, educator, conversational, promotional, and teaser.
- For Instagram Live: promote it in advance, use a compelling title and consistent schedule, begin with a strong hook, interact with comments, use Q&A/polls, improve lighting/audio/camera quality, keep sessions focused, collaborate with guests, and review Live analytics.
- For a Q&A Live: collect questions beforehand via a dedicated hashtag or DMs, announce a clear theme, briefly explain the format at the start, invite questions in comments, maintain an approachable atmosphere, prepare for common questions, keep answers concise, and use a moderator if needed.
- Ways to encourage questions: ask viewers to submit them beforehand and during the Live, use question stickers or other interactive features, offer appropriate incentives such as shoutouts or exclusive content, and follow up afterward with useful resources.
- After a Live: save/share the replay, post highlights or clips, and create a follow-up post summarizing key points.
- For influencer collaborations: prioritize audience relevance, engagement rate, content quality, authenticity, brand-value alignment, and clearly define deliverables, promotion, and expectations.
- Suggested collaboration formats: guest blog posts, social media takeovers, expert interviews/Q&As, content swaps, shoutouts/features, and co-created tips or resources.
- User plans to propose a guest blog post to Ashley Gaida about creating engaging Instagram content.
- User’s draft outreach message: “Hi Ashley, I've been following your content on content creation and digital marketing, and I love your insights. I think our audiences would really benefit from a guest post on my blog about creating engaging Instagram content. Would you be interested in writing a post for my audience?”
- Suggested improvement: briefly introduce the blog and its audience, e.g. that it focuses on helping entrepreneurs and small business owners build their online presence, and explain why Ashley’s insights would resonate.
- Revised message: “Hi Ashley, I've been following your content on content creation and digital marketing, and I love your insights. My blog focuses on helping entrepreneurs and small business owners build their online presence, and I think your insights on creating engaging Instagram content would really resonate with them. Would you be interested in writing a guest post for my audience on this topic?”

No exact event name, Instagram Live Q&A topic, or verified follower count has been shared.
